description: “downdetector” is trending in BR with 20,000+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Diário de Notícias and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “downdetector”
paragraphs: “downdetector” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BR (snapshot taken 2026-11-12T18:55:09+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 20,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Diário de Notícias, Folha de S.Paulo, O GLOBO. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Usuários relatam falhas no Outlook nesta quinta-feira (12) - 12/11/2026 - Política” — Folha de S.Paulo
“Outlook e Teams apresentam instabilidade nesta quinta-feira” — O GLOBO
“Falha nos serviços da Microsoft deixa milhares de utilizadores sem acesso ao email e afeta o Copilot” — Diário de Notícias

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:50:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-12T18:55:09+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-12T18:56:23+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Diário de Notícias, Folha de S.Paulo, O GLOBO. The associated headlines are: “Usuários relatam falhas no Outlook nesta quinta-feira (12) - 12/11/2026 - Política” (Folha de S.Paulo); “Outlook e Teams apresentam instabilidade nesta quinta-feira” (O GLOBO); “Falha nos serviços da Microsoft deixa milhares de utilizadores sem acesso ao email e afeta o Copilot” (Diário de Notícias).
Google reports at least 20,000 searches in BR as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers BR. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
